title: EMLA
description: A sample course demonstrating the capabilities of the Adapt Framework
body:
EMLA is used to provide topical anaesthesia. This module will cover the anatomy and physiology relevant to topical anaesthesia, including skin and neurotransmission.
Pain will also be discussed.
notes:
Notes

  1. For additional information on any of the modules, refer to the Course Learner Guide. Check out the additional reading material in the References document and browse through the Glossary to look up definitions. All these documents are available in the section of the course.
  2. All defined terms used throughout the course will be highlighted in blue. If you need to clarify the meaning of a term, just hover the cursor over the blue highlighted term in a desktop view or tap it in a mobile view.
  3. Please ensure you select all interactivities and view the content. The assessment will only be unlocked if you do this.
  4. To further develop your learning journey please contact the Global Aspen Learning Academy for extra learning material.
    kirlearningacademy@ie.aspenpharma.com
  5. The course will be considered passed only if you successfully complete the assessment of all modules.
